name: Mubadala

summary.text: Mubadala Investment Company is a sovereign investment company owned by the government of Abu Dhabi. It committed $15 billion to the SoftBank Vision Fund at its 2017 first close and in March 2024 co-founded the Abu Dhabi AI investment vehicle MGX with the technology group G42.

facts.claim: Mubadala committed $15 billion to the SoftBank Vision Fund, disclosed at the fund's May 2017 first close alongside up to $45 billion from Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund.
facts.quote: Mubadala committed $15 billion, according to a separate statement.

facts.claim: MGX, an Abu Dhabi AI investment company, was launched in March 2024 by Mubadala Investment Company and G42, with Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan, the UAE's national security adviser, as chairman.
facts.quote: MGX was launched in March 2024 by Mubadala Investment Company and G42, the Abu Dhabi AI group.
